title: Paired causal isolation of delta-bar-delta path memory on the real FGC44 carrier
question: On the exact real-FGC44 G21B FRESH/HISTORY experiment, does disabling MODFLOW nonlinear under-relaxation from solver initialization remove the persistent HISTORY-minus-FRESH outer-2 head offset that remains with standard MODERATE delta-bar-delta?

causal_design.intervention_arm: MODERATE with UNDER_RELAXATION NONE, expected NONMETH=0
fixed_between_arm_pairs: same 1x3 transient GWF geometry and accepted origin
same K, SS, SY, CHD forcing and timestep
same solver head/linear tolerances and iteration budgets except disabling nonlinear under-relaxation

experiment_contract: Run four independent live MODFLOW models: STANDARD-FRESH, STANDARD-HISTORY, NOUR-FRESH and NOUR-HISTORY.
STANDARD uses the current G21B MODERATE solver configuration unchanged and must report NONMETH=3.
NOUR uses the same MODERATE tolerances and budgets but sets UNDER_RELAXATION NONE at model construction and must report NONMETH=0.
Within each HISTORY arm replay the frozen outer-1 lambda 1, 1/2, 1/4 response sequence, settling each response to its first MODFLOW convergence report before outer 2.
Within each FRESH arm enter outer 2 immediately after prepare_solve.
Stage and hold the exact frozen outer-2 response for 12 successive solve calls in every arm.
Never write X, XOLD, WSAVE, HCHOLD, DEOLD or any other MODFLOW state through XMI pointers.
Require XOLD bitwise fixed in all four arms and outer-2 HCOF/RHS bitwise identical within and across each solver configuration pair.
Record NONMETH and the final HISTORY-minus-FRESH head offset for both configurations.
Finalize_solve once per arm only after the fixed diagnostic tail; do not finalize_time_step.
quantitative_gates: STANDARD reproduces the persisted G21B call-12 HISTORY-minus-FRESH offset within 1e-12 m.
STANDARD reports NONMETH=3 in both arms.
NOUR reports NONMETH=0 in both arms.

All HISTORY outer-1 replay heads remain within 1e-12 m of their corresponding same-configuration FRESH response roots or, where the solver path differs, the measured replay is retained without changing the response sequence.
XOLD remains bitwise fixed in every arm.
Outer-2 HCOF/RHS are identical between FRESH and HISTORY within each configuration and numerically identical between STANDARD and NOUR.
Report the NOUR call-12 HISTORY-minus-FRESH offset and its magnitude relative to the 1e-12 m strict G21 scale.

interpretation_rules.delta_bar_delta_causal_support: STANDARD offset remains >1e-12 m and reproduces G21B, while |NOUR HISTORY-FRESH call12| <=1e-12 m.
interpretation_rules.delta_bar_delta_contributes_but_not_suff: NOUR reduces the absolute offset by at least 90% relative to STANDARD but remains >1e-12 m.
interpretation_rules.delta_bar_delta_not_dominant: NOUR reduces the absolute offset by less than 90%, or leaves a comparable/opposite persistent offset >1e-12 m.
interpretation_rules.mixed_or_unresolved: Lifecycle/convergence differences prevent a matched comparison without changing the frozen experiment.

pass_interpretation: PASS is a causal-isolation classification for this frozen real-FGC carrier only. Even DELTA_BAR_DELTA_CAUSAL_SUPPORT does not admit disabling under-relaxation in production or alter F-GC38/F-GC39; it only justifies a separately bounded solver-configuration/coupling-policy study.
fail_interpretation: Preserve failure. Do not alter solver tolerances, response sequence, 12-call tail, physics, G21 strict scale, or existing evidence to manufacture a cleaner causal classification.
